abstract: SCRIPT: Bitcoin Collateral Risk Assessment Framework The risk assessment framework that the Babylon team has been using internally for our native Bitcoin collateral protocol design. Bitcoin holders and applications can use SCRIPT to systematically assess the counterparty risks of any Bitcoin collateral solutions, including Babylon’s.
